SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q9. The pair of equations x = a and y = b graphically represents lines which are:
(a) Parallel
(b) Intersecting at (b, a)
(c) Coincident
(d) Intersecting at (a, b)

Answer / Solution:
x = a is a vertical line; y = b is a horizontal line.
They intersect at (a, b).
Answer: (d) Intersecting at (a, b)
